data.summary: While this model leads a unit, roll a D6 as your Command phase begins. Until your next Command phase starts, the weapons of that unit's models gain the ability matching the result: 1-2 gives **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**, 3-4 gives **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**, 5-6 gives **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)**.
